name: Aargau
description: Aargau was a planet in the galaxy's Core Worlds, in grid square L-10 on the Standard Galactic Grid, that was headquarters of the Bank of Aargau. Colossal seventh-stage bank-courier repulsor-trucks were used on Aargau. It was considered one of the financial centers of the galaxy. In 9 ABY, Aargau was mentioned on credits given to Boba Fett.
